BuildplateSilicone AC Heater 200x200mm1250³Keenovo (120v)Keenovo (220v)The heater size and power rating are not critical to have exactly at spec. The mat needs to be smaller than the bed so you have room for mounting hardware and an external thermal fuse. If the mat is underpowered, it will take longer to heat your bed. If it is overpowered, you can use firmware control to have it use less power. Using an overpowered heater at max power will heat your bed faster but make it more prone to warping. Choose an AC voltage suitable for your region. you do not need a thermoSTAT

BuildplateSilicone AC Heater 200x200mm250³Keenovo (120v)Keenovo (220v)The heater size and power rating are not critical to have exactly at spec. The mat needs to be smaller than the bed so you have room for mounting hardware and an external thermal fuse. If the mat is underpowered, it will take longer to heat your bed. If it is overpowered, you can use firmware control to have it use less power. Using an overpowered heater at max power will heat your bed faster but make it more prone to warping. Choose an AC voltage suitable for your region.

BuildplateSilicone AC Heater 200x200mm250³Keenovo (120v)Keenovo (220v)The heater size and power rating are not critical to have exactly at spec. The mat needs to be smaller than the bed so you have room for mounting hardware and an external thermal fuse. If the mat is underpowered, it will take longer to heat your bed. If it is overpowered, you can use firmware control to have it use less power. Using an overpowered heater at max power will heat your bed faster but make it more prone to warping. Choose an AC voltage suitable for your region.

The mat needs to be smaller than the bed so you have room for mounting hardware and an external thermal fuse. If the mat is underpowered, it will take longer to heat your bed. If it is overpowered, you can use firmware control to have it use less power. Using an overpowered heater at max power will heat your bed faster but make it more prone to warping.
